example.title: Champ's Ford Bridge, Road 100S over Clifty Creek
example.place: west of Burney, Clay Township, Decatur County, IN

brief: Multi-span stone arch bridge (three to four semicircular arches) of coursed limestone rubble with rock-faced voussoirs and a low, flat-topped stone parapet, carrying a narrow one-lane paved road straight across a wide shallow creek; wooded banks and a farmhouse at the end. 19th/early-20th-century county work (date not in the sources). Inventory span 0 m, sharing the spot with SMALL-28: model a single arch of this type.
